before.label: Pump A — Single liquid feed pump delivering premixed substrate and photocatalyst solution | Photochemistry HPLC pump
before.rationale: Deterministic stoichiometric flow solution: Q_A=k*(equiv/C)=0.5 mL/min; equiv=1, C=0.1 M; pump=pump_photo_liquid; concentration_basis=reference component: Fmoc-L-methionine; equiv_basis=reference component: Fmoc-L-methionine.

before.label: MFC B — Air MFC delivering reagent gas for singlet-oxygen generation | Air mass-flow controller
before.rationale: MFC inlet/STP flow=5.33636 sccm at 273.15 K and 1.01325 bar (22.412722 L/mol); pressure-corrected in-channel flow=1.45089 mL/min at 21 deg C and 4.01325 bar absolute; total gas=0.23809524 mmol/min, active O2=0.05 mmol/min (mole fraction 0.21); supplied=1 equiv O2 relative to limiting substrate.

before.label: T-mixer (PFA gas-liquid T-mixer, mixer_photo_t) | PFA gas-liquid T-mixer
before.rationale: Chemistry Plan: Stream A (liquid) premixed before reactor; Stream B (air) introduced via PFA T-mixer immediately upstream of photocoil to generate segmented Taylor flow. This ensures photocatalyst is uniformly distributed before gas contact, O2 is not present in feed lines (preventing premature oxidation), and segmented flow is established before the irradiated zone for maximum gas-liquid mass transfer.
